target_customer: Consumers and design-minded households buying indoor plants and ceramics online, mainly in California
problem: Buying and keeping indoor plants alive was hard for beginners. The company sells mature California-grown plants with a plant guarantee and care advice.
business_model: Direct-to-consumer e-commerce with local delivery and nationwide shipping

founders.name: Nicolas Bartoli
founders.background_notes: Crowdability describes a software engineering background; not confirmed by an opened primary source.

founders.name: Ron Radu
founders.background_notes: Named co-founder by LAmag and DTCetc coverage and the company's founders page introduction; not on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: E-commerce site plus logistics for live plants; packaging and delivery of living goods was the harder operational part.

defensibility.rationale: Plants and ceramics are widely sourced; differentiation rests on quality, packaging and service that rivals could copy.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Rivals grew separately; no source shows any copying or acquisition of Leon and George.

market_need_then: Growing consumer interest in houseplants and direct delivery; company reports 3 million USD revenue from 10,000 customers via a crowdfunding page (unverified).

branding.name_origin: Named for the founders' pets: Leon is Radu's cat and George is Bartoli's parrot, per LAmag.

identity.mascot_or_character: Named after a cat and a parrot, no mascot artwork confirmed
identity.visual_style: Premium lifestyle plants and luxury ceramics
identity.voice_and_tone: Informal founders page introducing 'Ron and Nico', plant doctors and 45 day plant guarantee

branding.brand_signature: Plant Doctors and 45 day plant guarantee
branding.community_and_virality: The press kit describes a vast following; not independently measured.

brand_strength.rationale: The company says it has cultivated a vast following, LAmag and Business Insider covered it, and it launched a product line, but follower numbers were not verified.

outcome_analysis: Leon and George stayed a small consumer plant retailer based in Los Angeles with about 10 people, launching a plant care elixir line in 2023. No acquisition or shutdown was found. Funding found was minimal, so growth looks mostly organic and modest.
notes: Unverified: CB Insights shows 360K USD over 4 rounds including a 0.19M USD convertible note in March 2020 and Wefunder as an investor; Crowdability describes equity crowdfunding. Neither was cross-checked, so no rounds are recorded and coverage is none_found. The press kit says it was seed funded through YC. Startup-seeker names a different founder (Ludovic Raymond) and CB Insights names only Bartoli, both treated as unreliable. Founders page and press kit pages returned 403 to direct fetch. Competitor searches did not give dated sources near 2017, so the list is empty. Completeness pass: a Wefunder Reg CF campaign raised 188,146 dollars and closed 2020-03-13 per the campaign page (SAFE, 9M valuation cap per KingsCrowd, not recorded as post-money). CB Insights reports 360K over 4 rounds including a 0.19M convertible note in 2020-03, which is not itemized here. Coverage is partial. LA Magazine confirms Ron Radu as co-founder.
